exposure: In vitro fertilization (IVF) in women aged 40 years or older
cohort: 29 women who underwent IVF at age 40 or older (study group) and a control group of women with spontaneous pregnancies
finding: Women aged 40 years or older who underwent IVF experienced a higher rate of pregnancy, delivery, and neonatal complications compared to women with spontaneous pregnancies.
mod_finding: The proportion of cesarean sections was significantly higher in the IVF group (84.62%) compared to the control group (21.87%).
birth_weight: Birth weight < 1,500 grams and < 2,500 grams was assessed.
